name: SVC_BI_AUDIT_SR
description: Captures SR audit data from the SR shadow table (SVC_SERVICE_REQUESTS_), adding useful attributes needed for BI reporting, for a select set of SR attributes that BI wants to report on.

columns.name: AUDIT_SR_ID
columns.description: Auto-generated number and primary key for this table.

columns.name: SR_ID
columns.description: Foreign key that references SVC_SERVICE_REQUESTS.SR_ID, the SR that the audit data belongs to.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: AUDIT_SEQ_NO
columns.description: Orders the audit records for a specific SR, with the first audit record having a value of 1, the next 2, etc.

columns.name: AUDIT_START_DATE
columns.description: The first date that the combined values of audited columns are valid from.

columns.name: AUDIT_END_DATE
columns.description: The last date that the combined values of audited columns are valid up to, but not including.

columns.name: AUDIT_DURATION_MS
columns.description: The difference between Audit_end_date and Audit_start_date in milliseconds, the duration of time the combined values of audited columns are valid; excluding the audit_end_date itself.

columns.name: LATEST_AUDIT_FLAG
columns.description: Identifies the latest audit record for an SR, a value of 'Y' for the record holding the current values of all audited columns, a value of 'N' for all other records.

columns.name: AUDIT_HISTORY_COMPLETE_FLAG
columns.description: Identifies SRs created after Auditing went live.  SRs created before this date will not have a complete history of audit data (N), while those created after will (Y).  Customers may want to filter out SRs with incomplete audit history.

columns.name: AUDIT_PURGE_DATE
columns.description: Reserved for future use, when purging of audit data is implemented.

columns.name: OLD_STATUS_CD
columns.description: Previous audited value from SVC_SERVICE_REQUESTS_.STATUS_CD.

columns.name: STATUS_CD
columns.description: Audited value from SVC_SERVICE_REQUESTS_.STATUS_CD.

columns.name: OLD_STATUS_TYPE_CD
columns.description: Previous audited value from SVC_SERVICE_REQUESTS_.STATUS_TYPE_CD.

columns.name: STATUS_TYPE_CD
columns.description: Audited value from SVC_SERVICE_REQUESTS_.STATUS_TYPE_CD.

columns.name: OLD_SEVERITY_CD
columns.description: Previous audited value from SVC_SERVICE_REQUESTS_.SEVERITY_CD.

columns.name: SEVERITY_CD
columns.description: Audited value from SVC_SERVICE_REQUESTS_.SEVERITY_CD.

columns.name: OLD_ASSIGNEE_RESOURCE_ID
columns.description: Previous audited value from SVC_SERVICE_REQUESTS_.ASSIGNEE_RESOURCE_ID.

columns.name: ASSIGNEE_RESOURCE_ID
columns.description: Audited value from SVC_SERVICE_REQUESTS_.ASSIGNEE_RESOURCE_ID.

columns.name: OLD_QUEUE_ID
columns.description: Previous audited value from SVC_SERVICE_REQUESTS_.QUEUE_ID.

columns.name: QUEUE_ID
columns.description: Audited value from SVC_SERVICE_REQUESTS_.QUEUE_ID.

columns.name: STATUS_SEQ_NO
columns.description: Orders the status code changes (including changes to null) for a specific SR, with the first audit record having a value of 1, the next audit record with a status code change has a value of 2, etc.

columns.name: STATUS_TYPE_SEQ_NO
columns.description: Orders the status type code changes (including changes to null) for a specific SR, with the first audit record having a value of 1, the next audit record with a status type code change has a value of 2, etc.

columns.name: SEVERITY_SEQ_NO
columns.description: Orders the severity code changes (including changes to null) for a specific SR, with the first audit record having a value of 1, the next audit record with a severity code change has a value of 2, etc.

columns.name: ASSIGNEE_RESOURCE_SEQ_NO
columns.description: Orders the assignee resource id changes (including changes to null) for a specific SR, with the first audit record having a value of 1, the next audit record with an assignee resource id change has a value of 2, etc.

columns.name: QUEUE_SEQ_NO
columns.description: Orders the queue id changes (including changes to null) for a specific SR, with the first audit record having a value of 1, the next audit record with a queue id change has a value of 2, etc.

columns.name: REOPEN_EVENT_FLAG
columns.description: Identifies if the SR has been reopened in this audited SR change ('Y' if yes, Null if no).

columns.name: SR_LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Copied from SVC_SERVICE_REQUESTS_.LAST_UPDATE_DATE.  For internal use only.

columns.name: CAT_PROD_HISTORY_COMPLETE_FLAG
columns.description: Identifies SRs created after Auditing of Category and Product went live.  SRs created before this date will not have a complete history of Category or Product audit data (N), while those created after will (Y).  Customers may want to filter out SRs with incomplete audit history when reporting on Category and/or Product changes.

columns.name: OLD_CATEGORY_ID
columns.description: Previous audited value from SVC_SERVICE_REQUESTS_.CATEGORY_ID.

columns.name: CATEGORY_ID
columns.description: Audited value from SVC_SERVICE_REQUESTS_.CATEGORY_ID.

columns.name: CATEGORY_SEQ_NO
columns.description: Orders the category id changes (including changes to null) for a specific SR, with the first audit record having a value of 1, the next audit record with a category id change has a value of 2, etc.

columns.name: OLD_PRODUCT_ID
columns.description: Previous audited value from SVC_SERVICE_REQUESTS_, derived as NVL(INVENTORY_ITEM_ID, PROD_GROUP_ID).

columns.name: PRODUCT_ID
columns.description: Audited value from SVC_SERVICE_REQUESTS_, derived as NVL(INVENTORY_ITEM_ID, PROD_GROUP_ID).

columns.name: PRODUCT_SEQ_NO
columns.description: Orders the product id changes (including changes to null) for a specific SR, with the first audit record having a value of 1, the next audit record with a product id change has a value of 2, etc.

columns.name: SCHEDULE_HISTORY_COMPLETE_FLAG
columns.description: Identifies SRs created after Auditing of schedules went live.  SRs created before this date will not have a complete history of working duration audit data (N), while those created after will (Y).  Customers may want to filter out SRs with incomplete audit history when reporting on working durations.

columns.name: OLD_SCHEDULE_ID
columns.description: Previous audited value from SVC_SERVICE_REQUESTS_.SCHEDULE_ID.

columns.name: SCHEDULE_ID
columns.description: Audited value from SVC_SERVICE_REQUESTS_.SCHEDULE_ID.

columns.name: WORK_DURATION_MS
columns.description: The time in milliseconds that the agent was available to work on the service request between audit_start_date and audit_end_date, as determined by the associated schedule_id. If audit_end_date is null, then work_duration_ms will also be null as it is only populated once an end date is determined.

columns.name: SCHEDULE_SEQ_NO
columns.description: Orders schedule id changes (including changes to null) for a specific SR, with the first audit record having a value of 1, the next audit record with a schedule id change has a value of 2, etc.

columns.name: SCHEDULE_ASSIGNEE_SR_ID
columns.description: Returns NULL if both SCHEDULE_ID and ASSIGNEE_RESOURCE_ID are null, otherwise returns SR_ID. This is intended to be used for Assignee related Schedule metrics.
